rows.grounds: Fused form: ghoraghoratarasya (of terrible-and-more-terrible) + ante (at end); internal sandhi noted, token kept whole.
Compound denoting the term expressing body-form.

items.question: Which mantra element is placed after the phrase ghoraghoratara in the prescribed sequence?
premises: The sequence reaches the end of ghoraghoratara.
After that point another element follows.
The following element is the body-form word.
items.inference: The body-form word is to be placed immediately after the end of ghoraghoratara.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tanurūpapada in this mantra context is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: At the end of the phrase 'ghoraghoratara', then place the body-form word, and then proceed further.
